request: Implement them all right now no excuses
scope: All 35 checklist items plus all observation-pipeline report limits; read-only continuation and planned acceptance attempt only

flaws.flaw: Frozen backbone plus refreshed retrieval and calibrated correction substantially overlaps existing work.
flaws.cause: FreshCast specifies that combination. TAFAS, COSA and the 2026 delay-aware audit also cover partial feedback, gated adaptation and causal-delay measurement.
flaws.repair: Reject that combination as the sole new contribution; compare explicit material differences against primary methods.
flaws.required_evidence: A claim-by-claim distinction and a falsifying experiment that does not reduce to an existing baseline.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Perfect forecasting is not an attainable universal acceptance criterion.
flaws.cause: Irreducible conditional variance and potentially adverse retrieval corrections.
flaws.repair: Use a named task, fixed practical improvement, risk limits and finite budget.
flaws.required_evidence: Conditional-risk derivation plus frozen empirical criteria.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Public residual writer subtracts the entire target and ignores its observation mask.
flaws.cause: Scorer truth and model observations share ForecastBatch.
flaws.repair: Separate ObservationEvent from scorer targets; gather visible coordinates before subtraction; retain validity and arrival metadata.
flaws.required_evidence: Mutating every hidden target, including NaN/Inf, leaves predictions, keys, normalization and memory checksum unchanged.
flaws.current_disposition: Observed-event core tested; actual tensor bridge tests blocked before import

flaws.flaw: Default target availability is event_time+1 despite variable lead_times.
flaws.cause: A missing explicit availability field silently assumes one-step observations.
flaws.repair: Require coordinate-level arrival times and original forecast ID; reject ambiguous availability.
flaws.required_evidence: Multi-horizon delayed and out-of-order reveal tests; zero future contributions.
flaws.current_disposition: Observed-event core tested; actual tensor bridge tests blocked before import

flaws.flaw: Evaluator and verifier compute different relative L2 reductions.
flaws.cause: Mean sample ratios versus pooled energy ratio.
flaws.repair: Freeze one estimand and reduction order; use independent implementations of that same definition.
flaws.required_evidence: Unequal-energy fixture: mean 0.5 versus pooled sqrt(1/101); repaired paths must agree.
flaws.current_disposition: Reference validator and recorder implemented; full real experiment integration remains unverified

flaws.flaw: Non-finite claimed or recomputed metrics can pass verification.
flaws.cause: Comparisons involving NaN evaluate false; infinity minus infinity becomes NaN.
flaws.repair: Reject nonfinite inputs and nonfinite intermediates before tolerance comparisons.
flaws.required_evidence: NaN on either side and infinity on both sides must all fail.
flaws.current_disposition: Reference validator and recorder implemented; full real experiment integration remains unverified

flaws.flaw: Duplicate cells and families can satisfy required counts.
flaws.cause: Decision checks list length rather than exact unique expected identities.
flaws.repair: Construct expected matrix from frozen protocol and derive outcomes from verified raw rows.
flaws.required_evidence: Duplicates, missing IDs, extra IDs, wrong seeds and mismatched sources must fail.
flaws.current_disposition: Reference validator and recorder implemented; full real experiment integration remains unverified

flaws.flaw: Secondary regression and uncertainty gates are not fully enforced.
flaws.cause: Summary booleans and means substitute for all protocol requirements.
flaws.repair: Bind each gate to raw arithmetic, planned uncertainty and full per-family results.
flaws.required_evidence: 100 percent supplied family regression and unsupported confidence must never pass.
flaws.current_disposition: Reference validator and recorder implemented; full real experiment integration remains unverified

flaws.flaw: A boolean can assert independent reproduction.
flaws.cause: Identity and provenance are not independently established by the decision function.
flaws.repair: Require attributable external reproduction artifacts and human-reviewed independence; retain same-operator label locally.
flaws.required_evidence: An independent operator reproduces frozen results; self-assertion cannot unlock claims.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Bootstrap weighting differs from equal-cell macro weighting.
flaws.cause: Families contribute flattened trajectory rows.
flaws.repair: Define trajectory-to-seed-to-cell reductions, then dependence-preserving resampling.
flaws.required_evidence: Unequal trajectory counts retain the predeclared estimand: audit fixture expects 0.5, current function gives 0.1.
flaws.current_disposition: Reference validator and recorder implemented; full real experiment integration remains unverified

flaws.flaw: Pairing silently excludes unmatched or failed units.
flaws.cause: Only finite PASS rows and shared intersections enter statistics.
flaws.repair: Validate complete expected observations before computing paired summaries; retain failures explicitly.
flaws.required_evidence: Removing one candidate row must block complete-study adjudication.
flaws.current_disposition: Reference validator and recorder implemented; full real experiment integration remains unverified

flaws.flaw: Historical value/salience/temperature paths cannot all learn through forecast loss.
flaws.cause: Detached/no_grad writes, hard threshold and scalar conversion.
flaws.repair: Provide explicit learning losses or mark each policy fixed; keep trainable temperatures as tensors.
flaws.required_evidence: Finite nonzero gradients and actual parameter changes on informative delayed-recall unit cases.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Historical owner IDs are minibatch positions.
flaws.cause: Stable episode identity is not carried end to end.
flaws.repair: Use immutable episode IDs with explicit reset and split namespaces.
flaws.required_evidence: Batch reorder and batch-size changes preserve each episode's outputs.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: One owner without traces disables retrieval for the entire batch.
flaws.cause: The eligibility test requires every row to have a candidate.
flaws.repair: Return per-row and per-coordinate valid masks with independent base fallback.
flaws.required_evidence: Adding an empty unrelated episode leaves another episode's prediction unchanged.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Owners compete for a shared bank and may evict one another.
flaws.cause: Global capacity with owner-filtered retrieval.
flaws.repair: Choose per-owner quotas for isolation; evaluate shared capacity separately and account all bytes.
flaws.required_evidence: Owner isolation, eviction traces, fixed total and per-owner byte comparisons.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Historical compression discards location and amplitude information.
flaws.cause: Global pooling, normalized values and uniformly broadcast feedback.
flaws.repair: Preserve masked spatial residuals or a reconstructable basis; normalize keys separately.
flaws.required_evidence: Known-source reconstruction, amplitude scaling and localized intervention tests.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: V3 tensor arm is a fixed weighted retrieval estimator.
flaws.cause: Raw cue distances, top-k softmax, FIFO and scalar calibration.
flaws.repair: Name it accurately and retain it as a reference.
flaws.required_evidence: Any more complex candidate must beat matching kNN/kernel/local-linear controls.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Short-context baselines may lose because they receive less history.
flaws.cause: Memory exposes past observations outside their window.
flaws.repair: Match legally available information and include genuinely longer-history controls.
flaws.required_evidence: Gain survives context and information matching.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Online revealed-target prediction is not open-loop forecasting.
flaws.cause: True future observations may be appended between predictions.
flaws.repair: Separate assimilation, delayed feedback and open-loop tracks.
flaws.required_evidence: Open-loop memory receives no true future values; report each track separately.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Mask normalization does not correct informative missingness.
flaws.cause: Observed residuals may be selected by unobserved outcomes.
flaws.repair: Declare MCAR/MAR assumptions, examine support and positivity; do not claim MNAR identification without extra information.
flaws.required_evidence: Missingness stress tests and sensitivity analysis; propensity corrections compared with established estimators.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Similarity need not imply future residual agreement.
flaws.cause: Stale observations or regime changes break conditional stationarity.
flaws.repair: Diagnose residual correlation by age and regime before adding age weights or gates.
flaws.required_evidence: Gain under declared shifts and bounded harm; no universal guarantee.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Erasing an additive correction automatically removes its gain.
flaws.cause: Full-minus-base arithmetic is reused as evidence of information content.
flaws.repair: Add relevant versus irrelevant deletion, matched replacements and key/value mispairing.
flaws.required_evidence: Distinct predictions for informative interventions with coverage reported.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: New owners do not necessarily mean new dynamics.
flaws.cause: V3 shares cue dictionary and mixing across partitions.
flaws.repair: Separate owner, dictionary, dynamics, geometry and noise shifts.
flaws.required_evidence: Complete unseen-dynamics and dictionary results beyond in-distribution owners.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Optimization seeds, trajectories and domains are different units.
flaws.cause: A single seed can jointly change task generation and optimization.
flaws.repair: Separate RNG streams and define crossed/nested uncertainty.
flaws.required_evidence: Prospective power and uncertainty plan with preserved pairing and dependence.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Five paired signs cannot yield two-sided exact p below 0.0625.
flaws.cause: The smallest two-sided probability is 2/2^5.
flaws.repair: Choose adequate independent units prospectively; report effect sizes and uncertainty.
flaws.required_evidence: Declared sample-size justification; no seed additions selected for significance.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Historical SelectiveSSMSystem does not establish an official temporal SSM reproduction.
flaws.cause: The inspected implementation is a feedforward convolutional stack.
flaws.repair: Verify state and use the admitted upstream recipe and longer-history controls.
flaws.required_evidence: History perturbation and independent upstream validation reproduction.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Small runtime tests did not establish full-campaign memory fit.
flaws.cause: V3 stopped mid-cell under global host pressure.
flaws.repair: Full-shape load probe before freeze; isolate candidate workers and stream checkpoints when equivalent.
flaws.required_evidence: Measured peak memory/time/output safety margin; retain resource failures.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Frozen v3 cannot be silently restarted.
flaws.cause: One-campaign marker was consumed before partial execution.
flaws.repair: Keep v3 intact; any new campaign needs new source, hypothesis, budget and failure policy.
flaws.required_evidence: Consumed-marker preservation and no duplicate execution.
flaws.current_disposition: Existing consumed marker preserved; no restart attempted

flaws.flaw: Continuation equivalence is not demonstrated.
flaws.cause: Optimizer, RNG, sampler, memory and budget state may diverge.
flaws.repair: Specify full checkpoint state and test interruption against uninterrupted execution on disposable development data.
flaws.required_evidence: Matching predictions and state within frozen tolerances without extra training opportunities.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Pinned source/data terms and complete data manifests are not admitted.
flaws.cause: Two upstream pinned trees have no named license file; datasets lack admitted hashes.
flaws.repair: Obtain applicable source/data terms and official split manifests before integration.
flaws.required_evidence: Authoritative permission/license receipts plus checksums; public visibility alone is insufficient.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Current historical source is not established as identical to every frozen experiment.
flaws.cause: Relocation, deletions and untracked successor files coexist.
flaws.repair: Keep exact source/config/environment hashes per result and preserve old trees.
flaws.required_evidence: Every historical attribution uses its executed source, not a similar current path.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Hard-clamped dynamics parameters can leave the active gradient region.
flaws.cause: Clamping after unconstrained updates can zero gradients.
flaws.repair: Compare smooth constraints or projected optimization in a bounded successor only.
flaws.required_evidence: Measured gradients, activity and held-out contribution.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Equal updates or parameter counts do not imply equal resources.
flaws.cause: Retrieval, adaptation, indexing, storage and tuning cost extra.
flaws.repair: Report full training/tuning/inference costs and Pareto comparisons.
flaws.required_evidence: Accuracy-cost advantage survives complete accounting.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: Verified source and tests do not establish publication completion.
flaws.cause: Independent review, PDF inspection and immutable release requirements remain open.
flaws.repair: Tie each paper claim to raw artifacts and complete separate release gates.
flaws.required_evidence: Reviewed manuscript, reproducible figures, verified package and explicit submission authority.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question

flaws.flaw: A privileged approximate oracle is not necessarily an information-theoretic optimum.
flaws.cause: A noisy most-recent observation can lose to averaging.
flaws.repair: Distinguish diagnostic upper capability from a proven Bayes bound.
flaws.required_evidence: Analytical assumptions or a documented proxy; failed proxy does not prove all history useless.
flaws.current_disposition: OPEN; no new repair round or model trial authorized by the pending budget question
